description: Figure 7, located at the bottom of a two-plot pair, displays two line graphs that illustrate the accuracy of the Llama3.3 model in relation to entity popularity metrics. The top graph plots accuracy against the subject popularity (s_pop) frequency, with the x-axis labeled "s_pop frequency (x10^4)" and ranging from 1 to 19. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy," ranges from 0.0 to 1.0. This graph shows two lines: "Initial Accuracy" (green, with square markers) and "Final Accuracy" (blue, with circle markers). The "Final Accuracy" line starts at approximately 0.7, rises to a peak of about 0.95 around an s_pop frequency of 13, and then slightly declines. The "Initial Accuracy" line starts at approximately 0.4, rises to a peak of about 0.7 around an s_pop frequency of 13, and then declines. The bottom graph plots accuracy against the object popularity (o_pop) frequency, with the x-axis labeled "o_pop frequency (x10^4)" and ranging from 1 to 19. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy," ranges from 0.0 to 1.0. This graph also shows two lines: "Initial Accuracy" (green, with square markers) and "Final Accuracy" (blue, with circle markers). The "Final Accuracy" line starts at approximately 0.7, rises to a peak of about 0.95 around an o_pop frequency of 13, and then slightly declines. The "Initial Accuracy" line starts at approximately 0.4, rises to a peak of about 0.7 around an o_pop frequency of 13, and then declines.
